tools.name: search_peptides
tools.description: Search the Peptide Library research database by name, synonym or alias (fuzzy), optionally filtered by research category or research area. Returns short educational profiles with evidence level and the canonical Peptide Library URL. Use get_peptide_details for the full profile. No dosing information

tools.name: get_peptide_details
tools.description: Full educational research profile for one peptide: classification, mechanism and targets, research areas, evidence by tier (regulatory label, controlled human trials, other human studies, secondary reports, animal and in-vitro research) with cited sources, safety and side effects, regulatory status

tools.name: compare_peptides
tools.description: Side-by-side research comparison of 2-3 peptides on structured profile fields: mechanism and targets, research areas, evidence level and human-trial availability, safety and side effects, FDA/WADA status, half-life and studied routes, with references. Each row says whether the values are the same, d

tools.name: search_research
tools.description: Search Peptide Library's own educational content: the site FAQ, per-peptide FAQs, published articles and free courses. Returns titles, short snippets and links with source attribution (no full text, no third-party articles). Dosing, reconstitution and injection guides, and content about buying, vend

tools.name: get_peptide_categories
tools.description: List the Peptide Library research categories (e.g. GLP-1/Metabolic, Cognitive, Longevity) with a description, the number of profiles and every profile in each, with links. Use a category id with search_peptides to filter.

tools.name: get_research_trends
tools.description: This week's most-researched peptides in the Peptide Library community (Trending Now, last 7 days): rank, share of researchers and growth as percentages, with what moved. Aggregate and privacy-preserving: no head counts, no individual activity, small cohorts suppressed. Popularity is not evidence of

tools.name: convert_units
tools.description: Convert an amount between mg and mcg exactly. IU ↔ mass conversion only works with a peptide whose profile documents an IU-per-mg factor (pass `peptide`); otherwise the result is an iu_factor_missing issue, never an assumed factor. Pure arithmetic: not a dosing recommendation.

tools.name: solution_concentration
tools.description: Concentration of an amount dissolved in a volume of liquid (amount ÷ volume), as mg/mL, mcg/mL and, with a peptide's documented factor, IU/mL. Pure arithmetic on the given numbers: it does not suggest amounts, volumes or how to prepare anything.

tools.name: blend_concentrations
tools.description: For several components dissolved together in one volume: each component's concentration and its share of the blend by amount. Arithmetic only; it says nothing about whether components can or should be combined.

tools.name: cost_per_amount
tools.description: Price arithmetic for a purchase: total cost (price plus optional shipping) and cost per mg, per mcg and (with a peptide's documented factor) per IU. Uses only the numbers given; it never estimates prices or shipping and converts no currencies.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_peptides, get_peptide_details · Private data: search_peptides, convert_units · Public sink: get_research_trends, blend_concentrations.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_peptides, get_peptide_details · Private data: search_peptides, convert_units · Public sink: get_research_trends, blend_concentrations

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
